system.description:
A bulky suit of hard combat armor, worn over a padded undersuit. The armor plates and ablative layers are reinforced by a nanotech self-repair mechanism that allows the armor to remain effective even during intensive combat. The armor contains servomotors to assist the wearer with movement, and the Tech Level 4 version even contains limited anti-grav suspensors designed to offset the weight of the armor, granting enhanced mobility. Someone wearing heavy armor is expecting heavy fighting, and is best avoided.

Tech Level 3 Heavy Armor is Armor which provides Protection of 5. Tech Level 4 Combat Armor provides Protection 6 instead. In either case, this Protection is reduced to half (rounding up) by attacks with the breaker keyword. Heavy Armor is a powered item, which recharges after a Bed rest. It is also scary.
